method.order: AB/BA alternating, three warmup pairs excluded
method.cache: OS cache warm, no forced GC; DB restored from each variant own initial seed per append sample; every scenario opens a new connection
method.refresh: refreshSummary return including session commits; DB open, source preparation/restoration and validation excluded
method.parseAndStage: synchronous reader processBatch: A line/JSON/adapter/TEMP, B line/JSON/adapter/memory DTO; includes name metadata; nested within reader and total refresh
method.map: B keeps local usage winners while reading; final grouping/validity filtering precedes selected TEMP load; mapMergeMs is final merge only, streaming greedy work remains within parseAndStageMs; selectedLoadMs includes mapMergeMs
method.profile: one separate untimed diagnostic run per variant; JSON.parse and row adapter clocks plus memory sampled after each batch; JSON.parse includes parser rows and lightweight evidence/dependency-key decoding
method.memory: process high water includes earlier scenarios, module load and validation; batch samples can miss transient peaks; heap/RSS are not per-stage allocation
method.independentOracle: Original frozen SQL product is the semantic reference for parsed local logs; synthetic request/token totals are generated directly; JS independently aggregates persisted requests to validate query groups and averages
method.queries: all result pages; each sample three warmups and ten calls, original filter and completed-request denominator
method.append: 1 Claude; 1,100,1000 Codex requests added to same largest accepted file, counts before addition; entire changed file reparsed
method.snapshot: Independent copies of a previously frozen current snapshot; synthetic sets generated once; only benchmark copies appended; source paths/content excluded from report
method.signatures: A uses old literal raw-event signatures; B/M may use versioned streaming signatures. Literal metadata SHA recorded but not required equal; facts and dependency SHA must match.
method.seeds: A appends from original SQL seed; B appends from B-built seed for steady-state; M appends from original SQL seed to test cache migration
method.migration: One separate M six-scenario run after trials, excluded from timing summaries; semantics/dependencies checked against A and B
method.nestedClocks: reader includes parseAndStage; prepare includes selectedLoad; selectedLoad includes mapMerge; do not add nested clocks
method.inputWork: Read files/bytes/JSON rows are recorded, not required equal because guarded recovery may reread a component; every changed file must be read from its start, source hashes must restore. Output semantics and dependency hashes remain strict.
